method: The archive's milestones as races, computed from api/v1/milestone-watch.json (bands + summit), data/artist.json (plays and upload dates), api/v1/milestones.json (crossed milestone dates), api/v1/session-clusters.json (session records), and api/v1/eras.json (era records). Race figures are simple snapshot arithmetic: current value, target, gap, and an at-pace figure that is pace-arithmetic, never a prediction.
pace_definition: pace_per_day = snapshot plays ÷ days from the track's upload date to the 2026-10-11 snapshot. A lifetime average, not a current rate. days_at_pace (plays still needed ÷ pace) and catch_days_at_pace (summit gap ÷ pace) are plain division - an honest arithmetic estimate, never a prediction.
